definitions.gloss: invincible; unbeatable; matchless; having no rival
definitions.explanation: Having no rival or opponent who can defeat you. Used in sports, games, and figuratively for anyone or anything that is overwhelmingly dominant.

examples.japanese: あのチームは{今|いま}{無敵|むてき}だ。
examples.english: That team is invincible right now.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{剣道|けんどう}で{無敵|むてき}の{強|つよ}さを{誇|ほこ}っている。
examples.english: He boasts unbeatable strength in kendo.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}は{自分|じぶん}が{無敵|むてき}だと{思|おも}っていたが、{年|とし}を{重|かさ}ねるにつれて{謙虚|けんきょ}になった。
examples.english: When I was young I thought I was invincible, but as I got older I became humbler.

notes:
Literally means having no ({無|む}) enemy/rival ({敵|てき}). Describes a state of being unbeatable or having no match.

USAGE:
- Can function as a noun or a na-adjective: {無敵|むてき}の{強|つよ}さ or {無敵|むてき}な{存在|そんざい}
- Used in sports, games, martial arts, and figuratively for anyone or anything dominant
- Very common in video game terminology — {無敵|むてき}モード (invincibility mode), {無敵|むてき}{状態|じょうたい} (invincible state)
- Also used hyperbolically in casual speech: {彼女|かのじょ}の{笑顔|えがお}は{無敵|むてき}だ (her smile is unbeatable)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無敵|むてき}の{強|つよ}さ: unbeatable strength
- {無敵|むてき}{状態|じょうたい}: invincible state
- {無敵|むてき}の{艦隊|かんたい}: invincible fleet (the Spanish Armada)
- {向|む}かうところ{敵|てき}なし: having no match wherever one goes (idiomatic synonym)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最強|さいきょう}: the strongest — superlative rather than absolute; implies comparison
- {不敗|ふはい}: undefeated — focuses on the record rather than the quality
- {天下無双|てんかむそう}: peerless under heaven — a more literary/dramatic synonym
